title: Denver
sideASummary: Infection deck back. Biohazard symbol. No text and no printed code.
sideBSummary: Blue Denver Infection card. City name down the left edge, blue western North America map, green infection mark. No rules text. The scan is numbered P1-09b.

rules: Blue Infection card for Denver. Two copies share this face.
Both copies go to the reserve when the package is opened, and move to the Game End area when Denver joins the grid.
notes: Card id 907. Count 2. The shared scan is printed P1-09b.
The 20-card numbering has no other image for P1-10b, the likely code of the second physical copy.
